app.name: RepCoun
app.sub: AI rep counter that works with camera — even fully offline.
onboard.title: Welcome to RepCoun
onboard.sub: Point the camera at your workout — RepCoun detects the movement, counts every rep and burns calories.
onboard.name: What should we call you?
onboard.body: Your body stats (used for calorie accuracy)
onboard.camera_sub: RepCoun needs the camera to see your movements. Images are processed on your phone — nothing is uploaded.
home.start_sub: Camera on · AI tracks your reps
home.online_sub: Cloud data synced · tracking stays on-device
home.offline_sub: Local movement data active · full tracking works
home.need_cam_sub: Grant camera access to start tracking.
workout.place: Step back so your whole body fits in the frame
workout.loading_model_sub: First start takes a few seconds. Works offline after this.
workout.cam_error_sub: Close other apps using the camera, then try again.
workout.cam_permission_sub: Allow Camera for RepCoun in Settings, then tap Try again.
workout.model_error_sub: Close the app fully and open it again. If it keeps happening, install the newest RepCoun build.
workout.mini_hint: RepCoun floats above other apps and keeps counting 📌
progress.title: Progress
progress.no_history: No workouts yet. Start your first session!
progress.clear_q: Delete all workout history? This cannot be undone.
progress.from_apps_sub: Workouts other apps synced to Health Connect (Home Workout, Samsung Health, …)
lb.title: Leaderboard
lb.sample_note: Sample season shown — connect a leaderboard API in settings to compete globally.
lb.global_empty: Only you are shown until a leaderboard server is connected (Profile → Advanced).
profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.model_desc: The accurate model is better for slow, controlled movements. Fast model suits quick workouts and older phones.
profile.autodetect_desc: RepCoun recognizes the movement automatically. Turn off to pick exercises manually.
profile.hc_unavailable: Health Connect not available on this device
profile.hc_desc: Sync workouts to Health Connect and read heart rate from your watch (Galaxy Watch, Redmi Watch, …) for more accurate calories.
profile.clear_q: Delete profile, settings and all history?
tip.pushup: Keep a straight line from head to heels and lower until your elbows pass 90°.
tip.squat: Push your hips back, keep knees tracking over toes, thighs parallel to the floor.
tip.situp: Curl up one vertebra at a time — don't yank your neck.
tip.pullup: Start from a dead hang, pull your chest to the bar, control the way down.
tip.jack: Land softly with soft knees and clap hands overhead.
tip.lunge: Step long, keep your torso tall and both knees at ~90°.
tip.plank: Squeeze glutes, brace your core, don't let hips sag or pike.
tip.curl: Keep elbows pinned to your sides — no swinging.
tip.press: Press straight overhead and finish with arms fully locked.
tip.burpee: Chest to floor, jump tall, land soft and repeat.
tip.mc: Drive knees to chest quickly while keeping hips low.
tip.bridge: Drive through your heels and squeeze at the top for one second.
tip.custom: Do the movement with steady, full reps — the app learned this movement pattern.
tip.legraise: Keep your legs straight and lower them slowly.
tip.lateralraise: Raise arms to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
tip.wallsit: Back flat on the wall, thighs parallel to the floor.
tip.highknees: Drive knees to hip height and stay tall.
tip.donkeykick: Kick the heel up, keep the core tight.
tip.hipthrust: Drive through the heels and squeeze at the top.
profile.hc_manual: Permission screen was blocked. Grant RepCoun access on the Health Connect screen that opened, then tap Connect again.
profile.advanced_desc: RepCoun works fully offline. These are optional extras for power users.
profile.cloud_assist_desc: Send a camera frame to your own AI server for help spotting the exercise. Works without it too.
profile.lbapi_desc: Connect your own leaderboard server. Until it's connected, only you are shown.
profile.track_sync_desc: Save each RepCoun workout into Health Connect so your watch and other health apps see it too.
